prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Tank. The one reference defines creature silhouette and camera; independently draw continuous poses matching that identity. Matte dark brown rocky armor, light gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style, sharp legible silhouette at small game scale. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera and upper-left soft lighting. Massive squat broad quadruped with thick layered irregular rock-brown armor boulders, huge pale gray sinewy muscular FOUR legs, blunt low armored head and amber eye slit, broad heavy body. Preserve the reference's wide tank silhouette. No green/red/purple dorsal sacs, no extra limbs or spikes.
Facing for ALL frames: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-right, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-right. Never front-right. Do not rotate the camera or turn the body in later rows.
Strict grid: FOUR columns x 6 rows, exactly 24 full creatures. Canvas aspect width/height=4/6. Each equal square cell reserves at least 15% padding on every side around its creature. Consistent scale, center and foot baseline. NO touching/overlapping neighboring bodies, including wide collapsed corpses. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential heavy WALK frames, four legs take distinct weight-bearing steps, alternating diagonal pairs, subtle weight shift, stable armor. Row3: FOUR IDLE breathing poses, planted feet. Row4: FOUR shockwave WINDUP frames: hind legs brace, front limbs and chest gradually lift a little, ready to pound ground, preserve full anatomy. Row5: FOUR SLAM/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame both front feet firmly strike ground with head lowered, then armored body absorbs impact, shoulders recoil and settles; no drawn shockwave, dust, debris or ground. Row6: FOUR DEATH frames, heavy legs progressively lose support, armor settles flat, head rests, amber eye darkens.
Distinct articulated leg steps, stable four-leg anatomy, single head, consistent plates. Do not simply duplicate or transform one still. Empty background fully transparent alpha0, including between legs. No shadow, floor, labels, text, diagram lines, grid, particles or projectiles.
